definitions.explanation: A compiled list of specialized terms with their definitions, typically found at the end of a textbook, manual, or technical document.

examples.japanese: ⟦{巻末|かんまつ}→巻末：21973_kanmatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{用語集|ようごしゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a glossary at the end of the book.

examples.japanese: ⟦{専門|せんもん}→専門：01251_senmon⟧{用語集|ようごしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}した→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧。

⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あったら→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{用語集|ようごしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If there are words you don't understand, please check the textbook glossary.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{用語|ようご}→用語：04086_yougo⟧ (terminology, technical term) and {集|しゅう} (collection). Unlike a full dictionary, a glossary focuses on specialized vocabulary within a particular field or document.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{専門|せんもん}→専門：01251_senmon⟧{用語集|ようごしゅう}: technical glossary
- {用語集|ようごしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to create a glossary
- {用語集|ようごしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{参照|さんしょう}→参照：11866_sanshou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to refer to a glossary

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧: dictionary — a comprehensive reference work covering general vocabulary
- ⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧: dictionary, encyclopedia — a more formal term, often for specialized or encyclopedic dictionaries
- {語彙集|ごいしゅう}: vocabulary list — a broader collection of words, not necessarily with definitions
